 Elm Street closed in Enfield due to crash, police say 
 By Rob Polansky Published : Oct. 20, 2026 at 8:31 AM EDT | Updated : 20 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ENFIELD, Conn. (WFSB) - A one-vehicle crash closed a road in Enfield on Tuesday morning.
 Police said Elm Street was closed in both directions from Shaker Road to Washington Road.
 There were injuries; however, police said they were non-life-threatening.
 There’s no word on what caused the crash.
